reproducibility_gaps: No NetCDF payload was downloaded or opened, so file-level dimensions, attributes, checksums, and complete variable realization were not independently verified in Stage 3.
The full directory/file inventory was not normalized and checksums were not captured; provider/catalogue metadata are used for product-level technical description.
Provider generation/validation documentation is linked and summarized at product level, but the detailed technical-guide PDFs were not treated as a substitute for direct payload inspection.
notes: R3 reflects a versioned, publicly described and accessible dataset with clear citation/use terms, documented product families, format, coverage, variables, and a verified paper-specific use path.
R4 is withheld because the binary/file-level layer was deliberately bounded; no NetCDF payload was opened, checksummed, or independently validated.
No R5 claim is permitted in Stage 3.
